text:
maya (Hiring Manager): FYI  new SWE hire (Nina) starts Mon. I want a very short "onboarding sprint" outline I can paste into her welcome email + a tiny 30/60/90 compass. Also need a one-line "who to ping" for common blockers.
trent (People Ops): On it. Keeping it compact so managers can paste. Any special infra?
maya (Hiring Manager): No GPUs. Needs read access to infra logs, repo access, and docs-edit rights. Prefer device shipped to SF office.
ivy (IT): Will image and ship MacBook Air. Adding groups: eng, infra-read, docs-edit. CLI quick reprovision if needed:
```
rw-provision --user nina.s --groups eng,infra-read,docs-edit --device mac-air
```
ivy (IT): ETA imaging Mon 07:30 PT, delivery to SF desk.
trent (People Ops): Pasteable onboarding sprint (one paragraph + bullets):
- Prestart: verify delivery, HR forms, SSO invite, Slack.
- Day 1: People Ops intro (benefits, comp), manager 1:1 (expectations + team intro), buddy lunch, join standup.
- Day 2: Product deep-dive, repo walkthrough, assign a tiny starter ticket.
- Day 3: Pair on starter ticket, docs editing session, quick security intro.
- Day 4-5: Finish starter task, cross-team intros, EOW check-in with manager.
- EOW deliverable: open PR with small fix + 3-sentence "what I learned".
trent (People Ops): 30/60/90 compass (manager copy):
- 30d: onboarded to tooling, ship starter PR, complete security training.
- 60d: own a small backlog item end-to-end, regularly participate in demos.
- 90d: lead a minor improvement, reduce turnaround on own PRs, propose a process tweak.
omar (Security): Add: enable 2FA before infra access; KMS/HSM requires approval. Ill run 15-min security onboarding Tue 3pm. Docs: <https://security.redwood/onboard-basics>.
onboard-bot: New-hire packet assigned to nina.s. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO. Due: 2026-04-02 17:00 PT.
maya (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can you append a one-liner who-to-ping list?
trent (People Ops): Sure (copy/paste): IT/device/account - @ivy; Security/creds - @omar; People Ops/payroll - @trent; Buddy/questions - assigned by manager.
ivvy (IT): (typo, correcting) ivy here  device queued. Serial will be posted once imaged.
maya (Hiring Manager): Perfect. Scheduling a 20-min "first-week sync" Fri 4pm. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
